topics: Systems of two linear equations in two variables

body.en: Linear relationships are the backbone of the algebra domain: solving for a variable, reading slope and intercept, and handling two equations at once.
Slope-intercept form is \( y=mx+b \); slope \( =\dfrac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1} \). Solve a system by substitution or elimination — or graph both lines in Desmos and read the intersection.

caption.en: The system \( y = 2x - 1 \) and \( y = -x + 5 \) has exactly one unique solution at \( (2, 3) \) where the two lines intersect.

label.en: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Systems with Zero or Infinitely Many Solutions

body.en:
• No Solution (Parallel Lines): Occurs when lines have the same slope but different \( y \)-intercepts (\( m_1 = m_2, b_1 \neq b_2 \)). In standard form \( \frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} \neq \frac{c_1}{c_2} \).
  • Infinitely Many Solutions (Same Line): Occurs when the equations are scalar multiples: \( \frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{c_1}{c_2} \).
  • Distributing Negative Signs: In expressions like \( -(3x - 4) \), students often write \( -3x - 4 \) instead of \( -3x + 4 \).
  • Inequality Direction Flip: When multiplying or dividing both sides by a negative number, always reverse the inequality symbol (e.g., \( -2x > 8 \implies x < -4 \)).
  • Target Variable Trap: The SAT frequently asks for \( 2x - 1 \), \( x + y \), or \( y/x \) rather than \( x \). Never stop solving until you answer the specific expression requested!

question.en:
In the system of equations below, \( k \) is a constant. For what value of \( k \) does the system have no solution?
\[ \begin{cases} kx - 6y = 15 \\ 4x - 3y = 9 \end{cases} \]

solution.en:
For a system of two linear equations in standard form \( Ax + By = C \) to have no solution, the lines must be parallel (equal ratios of \( x \)- and \( y \)-coefficients, but unequal ratio of constants):

\[ \frac{k}{4} = \frac{-6}{-3} \neq \frac{15}{9} \]\[ \frac{k}{4} = 2 \implies k = 8. \]

Check constant ratio: \( \frac{15}{9} = \frac{5}{3} \neq 2 \), confirming the lines never intersect. Thus, \( k = 8 \).

question.en: If \( 5(2x - 3) = 3(x + 4) + 6 \), what is the value of \( 7x - 15 \)?

solution.en:
Expand both sides:

\[ 10x - 15 = 3x + 12 + 6 \implies 10x - 15 = 3x + 18. \]\[ 7x = 33 \implies x = \frac{33}{7}. \]

Substitute into the target expression \( 7x - 15 \):

\[ 7\left(\frac{33}{7}\right) - 15 = 33 - 15 = 18. \]
